newsitem.title: FRANCE: Placement of four pct in Cap Gemini taking place.
newsitem.headline: Placement of four pct in Cap Gemini taking place.

text.p: A placement involving 2.4 million shares in information technology group Cap Gemini, or 3.98 percent, is taking place on the market, fund managers said.
HSBC James Capel and Merrill Lynch have been given a mandate to place 1.2 million shares each, they added.
The placement is being carried out in a price range of 230 to 235 francs, according to one fund manager. Another said the price was 235 francs.
Cap Gemini was down 0.85 percent at 243.90 francs at 1057 GMT, after having hit a low of 237 francs.
